---
title: "Fixed Income"
---

Fixed-income instruments promise or reference cash flows over time. Their value depends on when those cash flows arrive and how they are discounted.

Begin with a single two-year fixed-coupon bond and reuse it to study:

1. [Bond pricing](bond-pricing.qmd): why yields and prices move in opposite directions.
2. [Duration](duration.qmd): how sensitive that price is to a small yield change.

The same example can later support convexity, yield curves, and portfolio interest-rate risk.
